info.title: PaintMixer API
info.description:
PaintMixer computes paint-mixing recipes with a Kubelka-Munk model fitted from
spectrophotometer drawdowns.

* **Paints**: library paints (calibrated) and loaded paints (on dispenser channels).
* **Calibration**: worksheet → measure → upload CSV → validate → fit (background) → model versions.
* **Mixing**: `POST /solve` ranked recipes, `POST /predict` forward model, `GET /gamut`.

Errors use `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

get.description:
Weighting tables (D65, A, F11; CIE 1931 2°) and sRGB constants exactly as the backend uses
them, so clients can run the forward model locally (see ``GET /models/{v}/spectra``).

schema.title: Response List Paints Api V1 Paints Get

post.description: Upsert paints from CSV (columns as in ``sample_data/paints.csv``).

schema.title: Response List Colors Api V1 Colors Get

post.description:
CSV columns: ``name``, ``source`` (optional) and one of ``hex`` | ``r,g,b`` (0-255) |
``L,a,b`` (D65) | ``r400..r700``. Existing (source, name) pairs are updated.

Plan the drawdowns. When an active model covers the paints, every row also gets the
colour it is expected to show on its background (finite film at the drawdown's gap).
Calibration CSV skeleton with blank spectra and weighed-mass columns.
Printable worksheet with blank actual-weight fields and reading tick boxes.
Validate a calibration CSV against the paint library without storing it.

post.description:
Build an **uncalibrated** model from each paint's swatch colours (``swatch_hex``, and
optionally ``tint_hex`` / ``tint_fraction``), so recipes can be tried before calibrating.
Expect several dE2000 of error; see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
